title: Opening of Sydney Opera House
description:
On October 20, 1973, Queen Elizabeth II officially opened the **Sydney Opera House**, one of the 20th century's most distinctive buildings.

Designed by Danish architect Jørn Utzon, its unique shell-like design has made it an iconic symbol of both Sydney and Australia.

The construction took 14 years and cost 14 times the original budget. It was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2007.
